name: Jekutiel
title: Father of Zanoah
summary: Jekutiel is a person mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles. He is known as the father of the inhabitants of Zanoah. He belongs to the descendants of Judah through Caleb and his wife Bithiah, who was Pharaoh's daughter.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Jekutiel is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the tribe of Judah's genealogy, where he is listed as the father of Zanoah.

keyEvents.title: Son of Bithiah, Pharaoh's daughter
keyEvents.description: Jekutiel was the son of Bithiah, Pharaoh's daughter, who was married to Mered from the tribe of Judah. This shows a remarkable connection between the tribe of Judah and the Egyptian royal house.

keyEvents.title: Founder of Zanoah
keyEvents.description: Jekutiel is described as the father of Zanoah, which in a biblical context means he was the founder or leader of the city of Zanoah in the region of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of Mered's descendants
keyEvents.description: Jekutiel belonged to Mered's lineage, part of the broader genealogy of the tribe of Judah that was carefully recorded in the Books of Chronicles.
